data.raw_text:
#CalmSunday #TrafficUpdate #Lekki #IkoroduRoad #LagosAbeokutaExpress 

Traffic is fluid within the metropolis; driving in and out of Lagos is a breeze as well. 

- Agege Motor Road to Lagos, Abeokuta, all the way to Abule Egba is good. 
Charity intersection, Social Club, Olaniyi is all good.

- Lekki Epe Expressway, Freedom Way in and out is good as well. Ajah, Abraham Adesanya, Sangotedo, Abijo, is all good.

- Ikorodu Road is good as well; Fadeyi to Anthony, Ojota, Ketu, and Mile 12 is good.

Our men are strategically located to ensure traffic on our roads is smooth.

@jidesanwoolu @drobafemihamzat @seunosiyemi_ 
@lagosMOT1  @Sola_Giwa @walemusa @Mr_JAGs @lagostraffic961
